For each subset and principal component, genes are ranked by their feature
loading score and tested for enrichment using `fgsea`. Positive loadings drive
one end of the component; negative loadings drive the other.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)

library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
```

```{r load}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_stroma)
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc)
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_mnc)
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_mnc)

PCA_REDUCTION <- paste0("pca.", proc_params$ref_assay)
```

```{r extract-loadings}
# Extract PCA loadings (genes × PCs) from each subset, then drop the heavy
# Seurat objects immediately to free memory.
LOADINGS <- list(
  stroma  = Seurat::Loadings(mpn_processed_stroma,  reduction = PCA_REDUCTION),
  hsc     = Seurat::Loadings(mpn_processed_hsc,     reduction = PCA_REDUCTION),
  mnc     = Seurat::Loadings(mpn_processed_mnc,     reduction = PCA_REDUCTION),
  hsc_mnc = Seurat::Loadings(mpn_processed_hsc_mnc, reduction = PCA_REDUCTION)
)

rm(mpn_processed_stroma, mpn_processed_hsc, mpn_processed_mnc, mpn_processed_hsc_mnc)
gc()
```

---

## 1. Parameters

```{r params}
# ── Edit these ────────────────────────────────────────────────
PCS_TO_TEST  <- seq_len(proc_params$n_pca_dims)
MIN_SIZE     <- 15
MAX_SIZE     <- 500
NPERM        <- 1000
PADJ_THRESH  <- 0.05
N_TOP_SETS   <- 10
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Two-letter abbreviations for MSigDB collection prefixes
COLLECTION_ABBREV <- c(
  "^HALLMARK_"    = "HM_",
  "^KEGG_"        = "KG_",
  "^REACTOME_"    = "RE_",
  "^WP_"          = "WP_",
  "^GOBP_"       = "BP_"
)

abbreviate_pathway <- function(x) {
  for (pat in names(COLLECTION_ABBREV)) {
    x <- sub(pat, COLLECTION_ABBREV[[pat]], x)
  }
  x
}

for (nm in names(LOADINGS)) {
  message(nm, ": ", ncol(LOADINGS[[nm]]), " PCs available in ", PCA_REDUCTION)
}
```

---

## 2. Gene sets

Databases: Hallmark, CP:KEGG, CP:REACTOME, CP:WIKIPATHWAYS, GO:BP.

```{r gene-sets}
MSIG_COLLECTIONS <- list(
  list(collection = "H",  subcollection = NULL),
  list(collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"),
  list(collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:REACTOME"),
  list(collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS"),
  list(collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP")
)

msig_parts <- list()
for (col in MSIG_COLLECTIONS) {
  msig_parts[[length(msig_parts) + 1]] <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
    species       = "Mus musculus",
    collection    = col$collection,
    subcollection = col$subcollection)
}
msig_df   <- do.call(rbind, msig_parts)
gene_sets <- split(msig_df$gene_symbol, msig_df$gs_name)
message(length(gene_sets), " gene sets loaded")
rm(msig_parts)
```

---

## 3. Run fgsea (all subsets)

```{r run-fgsea}
#| cache: true
subset_gsea <- list()
for (nm in names(LOADINGS)) {
  loadings_mat <- LOADINGS[[nm]]
  pcs          <- intersect(PCS_TO_TEST, seq_len(ncol(loadings_mat)))
  loadings_mat <- loadings_mat[, pcs, drop = FALSE]

  pc_results <- list()
  for (pc in colnames(loadings_mat)) {
    ranked         <- sort(loadings_mat[, pc], decreasing = TRUE)
    res            <- fgsea::fgsea(pathways    = gene_sets,
                                   stats       = ranked,
                                   minSize     = MIN_SIZE,
                                   maxSize     = MAX_SIZE,
                                   nPermSimple = NPERM)
    res$PC         <- pc
    pc_results[[pc]] <- res
  }

  gsea_all    <- do.call(rbind, pc_results)
  gsea_all$PC <- factor(gsea_all$PC, levels = colnames(loadings_mat))

  message(nm, ": ", sum(gsea_all$padj < PADJ_THRESH, na.rm = TRUE),
          " significant results (padj < ", PADJ_THRESH, ")")

  subset_gsea[[nm]] <- list(results = pc_results, gsea_all = gsea_all,
                            loadings_mat = loadings_mat)
}
```

---

## 4. Significant sets per PC {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r sig-table-tabs}
#| results: asis

for (nm in names(subset_gsea)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  gsea_sig <- subset_gsea[[nm]]$gsea_all |>
    dplyr::filter(padj < PADJ_THRESH) |>
    dplyr::arrange(PC, padj) |>
    dplyr::select(PC, pathway, NES, padj, size, leadingEdge)

  print(DT::datatable(
    dplyr::select(gsea_sig, -leadingEdge) |>
      dplyr::mutate(NES  = round(NES, 3),
                    padj = signif(padj, 3)),
    caption  = paste0(nm, " — significant gene sets (padj < ", PADJ_THRESH, ")"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter   = "top",
    options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
  ))

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

---

## 5. NES heatmap — top sets across PCs {.tabset}

Top `r N_TOP_SETS` sets per PC by |NES| (padj < threshold), union across all PCs.
Grey = not significant.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r nes-heatmap-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10

for (nm in names(subset_gsea)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  gsea_all <- subset_gsea[[nm]]$gsea_all
  gsea_sig <- dplyr::filter(gsea_all, padj < PADJ_THRESH)

  top_sets <- gsea_sig |>
    dplyr::group_by(PC) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(order_by = abs(NES), n = N_TOP_SETS) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::pull(pathway) |>
    unique()

  if (length(top_sets) == 0) {
    cat("No significant sets.\n\n")
    next
  }

  heatmap_df <- gsea_all |>
    dplyr::filter(pathway %in% top_sets) |>
    dplyr::mutate(NES_plot = ifelse(padj < PADJ_THRESH, NES, NA_real_)) |>
    dplyr::select(PC, pathway, NES_plot)

  nes_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(heatmap_df,
                                  names_from  = PC,
                                  values_from = NES_plot)
  nes_mat  <- as.matrix(tibble::column_to_rownames(nes_wide, "pathway"))
  nes_mat  <- nes_mat[rowSums(!is.na(nes_mat)) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(nes_mat) <- stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(rownames(nes_mat)), 55)

  nes_for_clust <- nes_mat
  nes_for_clust[is.na(nes_for_clust)] <- 0
  row_order <- hclust(dist(nes_for_clust))

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    nes_mat,
    cluster_rows = row_order,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color        = colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))(101),
    breaks       = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 102),
    na_col       = "grey90",
    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    angle_col    = 0,
    main         = paste0(nm, " — NES heatmap, top ", N_TOP_SETS, " sets per PC")
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

---

## 6. Per-PC enrichment plots (top 3 positive + negative) {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r per-pc-plots-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4

for (nm in names(subset_gsea)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  results      <- subset_gsea[[nm]]$results
  loadings_mat <- subset_gsea[[nm]]$loadings_mat

  for (pc in names(results)) {
    res_pc <- results[[pc]] |>
      dplyr::filter(padj < PADJ_THRESH) |>
      dplyr::arrange(NES)

    if (nrow(res_pc) == 0) next

    top_neg <- head(res_pc$pathway, 3)
    top_pos <- tail(res_pc$pathway, 3)
    show    <- unique(c(top_neg, top_pos))
    ranked  <- sort(loadings_mat[, pc], decreasing = TRUE)

    plots <- list()
    for (pw in show) {
      nes_val  <- round(res_pc$NES[res_pc$pathway == pw], 2)
      padj_val <- signif(res_pc$padj[res_pc$pathway == pw], 2)
      plots[[pw]] <- fgsea::plotEnrichment(gene_sets[[pw]], ranked) +
        labs(title    = stringr::str_trunc(abbreviate_pathway(pw), 50),
             subtitle = paste0(pc, "  NES=", nes_val, "  padj=", padj_val)) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
        theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 7),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7))
    }

    print(patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
            patchwork::plot_annotation(title = paste0(nm, " — ", pc)))
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::
